title: erica betsileana
intro: Erica betsileana, commonly known as the Tsarafangitra rosemary, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ericaceae. It is native to Madagascar and is prized for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant and anti-anxiety properties, which can help alleviate stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Erica betsileana include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
